meta.brief: Cinematic German-pharmacy HERITAGE brand story for LACALUT Flora fresh-breath toothpaste. ABSOLUTELY NO people, NO hands, NO body parts anywhere in any scene. NEVER open, squeeze or dispense the tube; NO paste, foam, ribbon, blob or droplet ever. Only cinematic macro beats of the real German Flora tube standing untouched, plus clean fresh-breath cues (fresh mint leaves, a bright water droplet, crisp morning light, premium stone surfaces). Language is COSMETIC ONLY — fresh breath, all-day freshness, tackles everyday mouth odour at the source, clean confident feeling — NEVER 'bad breath', never a disease, cure, treatment, solution or medical claim. German pharmacy craftsmanship since 1925, trusted quality.

storyboard.hook: For lasting fresh confidence, discovered through a century of German expertise.
storyboard.cta: LACALUT Flora. A century of German craft — try it for yourself.
storyboard.voice: A composed, warm Australian male narrator, mid-40s, deep and trustworthy, measured documentary pace with quiet confidence.
storyboard.character: None (no people on camera per brief).
storyboard.product: the LACALUT Flora toothpaste tube standing upright on a polished dark stone surface, real German label facing camera, white cap, tall slim proportions.
storyboard.world: A sleek, minimalist German pharmacy-inspired 'wellness sanctuary' with dark grey natural stone surfaces (e.g., polished slate or basalt) and subtle brushed chrome accents. Ambient light streams from a high window, suggesting crisp morning, complemented by moody, directional spotlights that highlight details.
storyboard.styleAnchor: A dramatic cinematic ad moment with moody directional lighting, a smooth crafted camera move, rich colour grade, and a strong hero beat on the product, embodying a film-grade, premium, and emotive aesthetic.

scenes.visual: A close-up on an antique, brass-bound German pharmacy ledger, its pages filled with elegant, handwritten script, illuminated by a soft, directional beam of light that casts deep shadows, hinting at history. This transitions to a crisp, modern detail: a single, dewy mint leaf resting on polished dark slate, dramatically lit by a focused, moody spotlight, creating strong contrasts.
scenes.motion: A rapid, sharp push-in to the antique ledger, holding for a beat. Then, a swift, almost imperceptible snap-cut transition to a smooth, slow track-right, revealing the mint leaf on the slate. The camera then gently cranes up to frame the leaf with elegant precision. A subtle, crisp 'shimmer' sound effect underscores the transition.
scenes.vo: For nearly a hundred years, German expertise has mastered lasting fresh confidence.

scenes.visual: An extreme macro shot opens on a cluster of delicate, sparkling silver-grey mineral crystal shards, sharply in focus. A subtle, almost imperceptible shift in light reveals a second, larger cluster of crystals further along the dark basalt surface, catching the light differently. Finally, a third beat shows the crystals appearing to gently dissolve or integrate into the smooth, dark basalt surface, leaving a pristine finish.
scenes.motion: A smooth, slow track moves alongside the initial crystal cluster, then subtly glides to reveal the second cluster. The camera then executes a deliberate, slow push-in towards the dissolving crystals, holding the final beat. A gentle 'sizzle' sound effect underscores the active formula.
scenes.vo: LACALUT Flora's unique formula targets everyday mouth odour where it starts.

scenes.visual: The LACALUT Flora toothpaste tube stands prominently on the polished dark stone counter, its label catching a precise, moody beam of light that emphasizes its premium finish. A second beat reveals a pristine, highly polished section of the stone surface nearby, reflecting the subtle glow of the light, suggesting ultimate cleanliness. The final beat shows the tube framed against a softly diffused background, hinting at a serene, expansive space.
scenes.motion: A deliberate, smooth crane-down and track-in camera movement focuses on the LACALUT Flora tube, settling to frame it clearly under a third of the frame. The camera then subtly tracks left to highlight the pristine polished stone surface. Finally, a slow, elegant pull-back reveals the tube in its serene setting. A soft 'click' sound effect cues the end of the shot.
scenes.vo: Experience that clean, assured feeling all day. LACALUT Flora — try it for yourself.
